overall_notes: The paper focuses on privacy-preserving text rewriting using differential privacy mechanisms rather than traditional NLG tasks. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization and consolidation. The paper evaluates privacy-preserving text generation outputs using standard NLG metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore) along with task-specific metrics (cross-entropy loss, percentage of unchanged words). No LLM or human evaluation was conducted.
